end.parentNote: Anika practised predicting movement by looking at curved and flat surfaces. They correctly identified that a ball rolls and that boxes and upright tins can slide or stack. Anika mixed up the idea that only balls can roll; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, try rolling a bottle or tin on its side and compare it with sliding the same object upright.
